tagline: Draw from a tile bag that never runs out and build a map piece by piece.
description:
Tile-topia is a tile placing game about building a map one piece at a time. The tile bag never runs out, so the map can grow forever.

How to play: tap a glowing square to preview the next tile there, rotate it until it fits, and place it. Finished data lanes, districts, coolant streams and server cores score points. Open ground fenced in by lanes becomes a Meadow. Seal special district shapes to raise Heart and Strip landmarks. Special tiles add bonuses and rerolls, and Hold saves a tile for later. Records track your longest road, biggest castle, longest river and biggest meadow.

Play alone or against bots, let Auto build the map for you, and switch between a top view and an isometric view. Skins change the whole look, from Cyber and Graphite on paper to City, War, West and Bunker.

The free demo builds maps up to 60 tiles with the Cyber and Graphite skins. Buy it to unlock the endless tile bag and the City, War, West and Bunker skins.

Plays in your phone or desktop browser.
